verdict: Avoid new iron & steel exposure in Bhubaneswar for now; lend only to asset-backed downstream fabricators with verified order books, and decline commodity re-rollers dependent on OMC ore allocation.
title: Bhubaneswar Iron & Steel: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**A re-roller buys sponge iron, scrap and billet, heats and rolls it into TMT bars, angles and structurals, and sells into construction and infra demand.** Cash turns on the spread between input cost and finished price, not on volume alone. Capex is heavy and lumpy — a rolling mill is a multi-year asset with no second use. **So when a proposal lands, check the ore or sponge sourcing contract first; if it is a spot purchase with no annual linkage, ask for the last twelve months of purchase invoices and the supplier concentration.**

## What has broken now
**Odisha is running behind the country on both demand signals: GST collections +0.5% Apr-to-date against India +6.1% [D], and electricity demand +5.1% against India +9.5% [D].** That is a local stress signal, not a national one — peer results are strong, with JSW Steel's September-quarter profit at Rs.5,279 crore against Rs.1,623 crore a year earlier [4], and Kirloskar Ferrous revenue up 17% y-o-y to INR 2,046.7 crore [6]. **The gap is input cost: Kirloskar's EBITDA margin fell as coking coal costs and rupee depreciation offset volume growth [6], and Brent at $113/bbl sits above the $75–100 band [D], which keeps freight and power expensive.** Locally, the ISA delegation to the Chief Minister in April 2026 asked for priority iron ore allocation and fiscal incentives for Odisha steel industries [2] — read that as evidence ore availability is tight, not as a solved problem. The AM/NS ore requirement assessment is still not done and a 92 ha block at Allaghat in Sundargarh is yet to be granted [3]. **So when a re-roller claims assured ore, ask for the allocation letter; if there is none, treat the margin as unhedged.**

## Where the growth is
**Pursue downstream fabricators and off-site steel processors serving construction, not commodity billet makers.** Sagar Business Ventures showcased off-site fabrication at TiECon Bhubaneswar 2026, claiming project timelines cut by almost 50% [1] — that is the borrower type with pricing power, because it sells a service, not a commodity. **Avoid standalone re-rollers with no captive power, no ore linkage and single-customer concentration.** Note plainly: sources say little about Bhubaneswar city itself; most local news is state-level, so lean on first principles and the peer set.

## How to grow safely
**Structure against stock and receivables, not against the mill.** Take monthly stock statements, monthly sales registers and quarterly GST returns reconciled to bank statements.
**If GST turnover for the borrower's own GSTIN falls two quarters running while Odisha state GST stays near +0.5% [D], pull the limit.**
